items.text: SCOTUS 5-4 upholds state grace periods for mail ballots arriving after Election Day in Watson v. RNC, rejecting the Republican National Committee's challenge to voting access.
Supreme Court agrees to hear Arizona NVRA case that could badly weaken the federal law protecting voter registration — a potential major rollback of voting rights.
Federal judge strikes down Trump's 2026 executive order targeting voter rolls and mail-in ballots as unconstitutional and unlawful.
SAVE America Act (proof-of-citizenship voting requirement) stalls in Congress as Trump's opposition to the bill blocks must-pass defense legislation; House Republicans are split.
South Dakota ousts its top election official at the GOP state convention in favor of a hand-counting advocate; New Hampshire appeals ruling striking down its proof-of-citizenship voting law.
